For  high  school  students,  the  final  years before graduation are often filled with pressure from all directions. While teachers and parents  focus  on  marks  and  entrance  exams,  many  students also  face  pressure  from  friends  to  fit  in  or  appear  "cool."  This creates a constant struggle between staying focused on studies and maintaining social (111) _______  The fear of missing out on group  activities  or  being  judged  can  distract  even  the  most serious learners. Over time, this pressure builds up and may lead to (112) ______ stress. Some  students feel torn  between expectations  and  personal  goals,  unsure of what truly matters. Experts  say  the  key  is  to  set  clear  priorities  and  learn  to  say (113)  _______when  needed.  Building confidence and developing time-management skills  can  help  students  find  balance. In the end, choosing self-growth over temporary approval brings long-term (114) _______ . True friends will never ask you to (115)
________ your dreams just to fit in.
SSC Stenographer 08/08/2025 (Shift 2)
- Q.111. (a) skills

items.text: Social  media  has  become  an  important  part  of  modern  life, especially among young people. It allows them to connect, share ideas,  and  express  themselves  freely.  However,  this  freedom also  brings  challenges.  Many  teenagers  feel  pressure  to  look perfect or appear popular online. They often compare their lives to others, which can affect their self-confidence. Experts suggest  that  it's  important  to  build  a  healthy  (116)____ toward social  media.  Instead  of  trying  to  copy  others,  young  users should  focus on their real-life goals and (117)____. Parents and schools also have a role to play by teaching students how to use digital tools (118)____. Setting screen-time limits and encouraging  outdoor  activities  can  help  restore  a  sense  of balance. In the end, technology should be a tool for growth, not a source of (119)____ . By using social media wisely, young people can turn it into a space of learning, (120)____ and real connection.

items.text: 'Rigorous'  means  extremely  thorough  and  careful.  The  given passage states that modern ethical debates tend to concern the conflict between deontological and consequentialist approaches,  each  providing  a  rigorous  methodology.  Hence, 'rigorous' is the most appropriate answer.
items.contextualized_text:
Sol.66.(b) rigorous
'Rigorous'  means  extremely  thorough  and  careful.  The  given passage states that modern ethical debates tend to concern the conflict between deontological and consequentialist approaches,  each  providing  a  rigorous  methodology.  Hence, 'rigorous' is the most appropriate answer.

items.text: The  phrase  'moral  actions'  means  actions  that  are  guided  by ethical  principles  and  values.  The  given  passage  states  that deontology requires respect for moral actions irrespective of the result. Hence, 'actions' is the most appropriate answer.
items.contextualized_text:
Sol.67.(b) actions

items.text: 'Outcomes' means consequences of actions. The given passage states that consequentialism judges on the basis of net outcomes. Hence, 'outcomes' is the most appropriate answer.

items.text: 'Immoral' means not considered good or honest by most people. The given passage states that objections against pure consequentialism  suggest it will allow immoral actions if these bring  about  maximum  overall  welfare.  Hence,  'immoral'  is  the most appropriate answer.
